blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in River Springs?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 6 houses listed in River Springs. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is River Springs a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 17% on only 6 listed, too few to read as a market type. The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in River Springs from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 4 houses and 0 condos and townhomes sold in River Springs over those 4 months; detached houses peaked in June with 2 sold.

faq.q: How big is River Springs compared with the rest of Coquitlam?
faq.a: In September 2026, River Springs held 1.4% of the 425 detached houses listed in Coquitlam.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in River Springs than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses held from 6 to 6 (+0.0%) between June 2026 and September 2026.
